news.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Delivery Lead Times Below Last Year, JPMorgan Says

Apple announced the iPhone 18 series on September 9, with pre-orders for the Pro and Pro Max models beginning September 12 and general availability scheduled for September 18.
